category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
rationale: The piece is visceral second-person sensory writing: collective inhale, physical crowd noise, half-second suspense at the snap, strangers hugging, and it never concedes that it is merely a game. Concrete lines about the stadium vibrating and the stopped running back drove the high score.
quote: First, understand: 70,000 people have stopped breathing at the same time.
